llm_response.reason: The website exhibits multiple scam characteristics: (1) Registered recently by a private individual not associated with The Pokémon Company (WHOIS). (2) Mimics the branding and structure of the official Pokémon Center store yet uses a domain and registration pattern not typical or licensed for Pokémon merchandise. (3) No external evidence or community discussion validates it as a legitimate seller. These red flags indicate it is a likely fake online shopping scam targeting Pokémon fans with counterfeit or non-existent products.
